## Project Overview

- **Type:** Monorepo (Bun workspaces: `apps/*`, `packages/*`) with 3 parts
- **Primary Language:** TypeScript (Bun runtime/tooling)
- **Architecture:** Loom engine library (`@telar/core`) consumed in-process by a Next.js cockpit, wrapped by a minimal Electron shell
- **Thesis:** "Generation is solved; verification is the moat." Looms are self-verifying units of work; a read-only Verifier gates progress and a human always accepts — there is no agent-callable accept.

## Quick Reference

### Web (`web`) — `apps/web`

- **Type:** web (Next.js App Router)
- **Tech Stack:** Next.js 16 (canary), React 19, Tailwind v4, shadcn "base-nova" on `@base-ui/react`, `@anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk`, streamdown
- **Entry Point:** `apps/web/app/layout.tsx`
- **Shape:** 11 routes, 56 API route files (63 handlers), hand-rolled SSE streaming (`lib/sse.ts`); no auth (local single-user cockpit); `@telar/core` runs server-side only (CLIENT-BUNDLE RULE: client files use type-only imports)

### Desktop (`desktop`) — `apps/desktop`

- **Type:** desktop (Electron shell)
- **Tech Stack:** Electron, electron-builder
- **Entry Point:** `apps/desktop/main.js`
- **Shape:** forks the packaged Next standalone server and opens one BrowserWindow; a small native `File` menu (no `Tray`), a `contextBridge`/`ipcMain` IPC surface (in-window native browser control, `electron-updater` auto-update, command-key menu events), and `--smoke` as the fail-closed packaging gate

### Core (`core`) — `packages/core`

- **Type:** library (TypeScript domain engine)
- **Tech Stack:** TypeScript, Bun test runner, `@anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk`, zod, yaml
- **Entry Point:** `packages/core/src/index.ts` (single package export)
- **Shape:** 59 source modules, 98 test files; deterministic tick-loop weaver, verifier/critic-panel stack, environment lanes, MCP OAuth 2.1 client, filesystem store under `TELAR_HOME` (~/.telar)

## Generated vs. Hand-Maintained

This documentation set is, as of this update, **implicitly both generated and hand-maintained,
and that ambiguity is a known hazard** (issue #10): the 13 files below (plus this index) were
produced in full by a single BMad `document-project` deep-scan run on 2026-07-17 and recorded
in [project-scan-report.json](./project-scan-report.json). Nothing has re-run that scan since.
In the meantime, product changes (auto-update, an IPC/`contextBridge` surface, a desktop CI/CD
pipeline, a cloud Worker) made several of that scan's claims false, and this pass hand-corrected
them in place rather than re-running the scan workflow.

**If the scan workflow is ever re-run, it must not blindly overwrite the five files below** —
doing so would silently revert the hand-corrections this update made, exactly as issue #10 warns.
Diff its proposed output against the current file before accepting it, or re-verify each of the
scan's claims against the code first (the correct fix either way, since a scan is a snapshot, not
a source of truth):

| File | Status |
|---|---|
| [architecture-desktop.md](./architecture-desktop.md) | Hand-maintained since 2026-08-06 — auto-update, IPC/contextBridge, `DesktopBrowserManager` |
| [deployment-guide.md](./deployment-guide.md) | Hand-maintained since 2026-08-06 — CI/CD workflows, packaging/signing config |
| [integration-architecture.md](./integration-architecture.md) | Hand-maintained since 2026-08-06 — `workers/updates-proxy` / R2 topology, renderer IPC surface |
| [index.md](./index.md) (this file) | Hand-maintained since 2026-08-06 — this section, plus the desktop/deployment-guide summary lines above |
| [project-scan-report.json](./project-scan-report.json) | Scan metadata only, **not re-stamped** by this pass — see the note at the top of that file; treat its `timestamps`/`completed_steps` as describing the *original* 2026-07-17 scan, not the current state of the four files above |

Every other file produced by the original scan (`architecture-core.md`, `architecture-web.md`,
`api-contracts-web.md`, `data-models-web.md`, `component-inventory-web.md`,
`component-inventory-desktop.md`, `development-guide.md`, `project-overview.md`,
`source-tree-analysis.md`, `project-parts.json`) was **not** re-verified claim-by-claim in this
pass and should still be treated as a 2026-07-17 snapshot until someone does — do not assume the
absence of a correction here means the file is current.

## Getting Started

Requires [Bun](https://bun.sh).

```bash
bun install                 # install all workspaces
cd apps/web && bun run dev  # cockpit at localhost:3000 (TELAR_HOME defaults to ~/.telar-dev)
cd packages/core && bun test  # run the core engine suite (98 files)
bash scripts/build-desktop.sh # full desktop packaging pipeline (smoke-gated)
```

See the [Development Guide](./development-guide.md) for environment configuration and the full command reference.

## AI-Assisted Development Guidance

- **Planning a brownfield PRD:** start from this index; the per-part architecture docs plus [Integration Architecture](./integration-architecture.md) are the load-bearing context.
- **UI-only features:** [Architecture — Web](./architecture-web.md) + [Component Inventory — Web](./component-inventory-web.md) (respect the status-tone vocabularies and the CLIENT-BUNDLE RULE).
- **Engine features:** [Architecture — Core](./architecture-core.md) + [Data Models](./data-models-web.md); note the design law — deterministic control flow in code, intelligence in the leaves.
- **API changes:** [API Contracts — Web](./api-contracts-web.md); the human-accept moat is structurally enforced — do not add agent-callable accept paths.
- **Scan state:** [project-scan-report.json](./project-scan-report.json) records what was scanned and when (resume/rescan metadata) for the *original* 2026-07-17 run — see [Generated vs. Hand-Maintained](#generated-vs-hand-maintained) before trusting it as current, and before re-running the scan workflow.
